$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFNN (AIP France, chart dated 2021-09-09): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Narbonne-Vinassan

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
Before using NARBONNE airfield, every pilot shall receive specific training set by a certified flight instructor user of this aerodrome.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of RWY by gliders and aeroplanes is prohibited.
Grass strip waterlogged after severe rainfalls.
Use of AD subject to prior information from ACB.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
Captain must check if ACFT takeoff and landing performance comply with airfield specifications.
Presence of a draining ditch, materialized by yellow beacons, vacating RWY by runway ends.
Low height circuit patterns reserved for home-based ACFT.
TWY: width 35 m.
QFU 283°: avoid overflying Narbonne during takeoff.
Downwind leg located south of Coursan.
AEM (NR 9538): HJ, 500 ft ASFC, as per protocol.
L'aérodrome ne peut être utilisé par un pilote que s'il a effectué une reconnaissance préalable du site avec un instructeur utilisateur du terrain.
AD interdit aux aéronefs non munis de radio.
Utilisation simultanée avions-planeurs interdite.
Bande gazonnée impraticable par fortes pluies, inondable si crues.
Se renseigner sur l'état des pistes auprès de l'aéro-club.
Site susceptible d'être envahi en quelques minutes par la brume de mer.
Le commandant de bord doit vérifier si les performances au décollage et à l'atterrissage sont compatibles avec les caractéristiques de l'aérodrome.
Présence d'un fossé drainant, matérialisé par des balises jaunes, dégagement par les extrémités de piste.
Circuit basse hauteur réservé aux aéronefs basés.
TWY : largeur 35 m.
QFU 283° : éviter le survol de Narbonne au décollage.
Branche vent arrière au sud de la commune de Coursan.
AEM (N° 9538) : HJ, 500 ft ASFC, selon protocole.
